hypothesis: Method-of-moments estimators of rho and of the innovation excess kurtosis from the same one-level noised data as E06 are unbiased and show the e^{2t} and e^{4t} error growth without saturating, at a constant 5-30x the Cramer-Rao reference: the high-noise competitor is rate-correct and inefficient.
design: E06's chains and noise draws exactly (rng tags 'e06-train', 'e06-noise'), M = 512, 16 seeds, the eight E06 levels; rho_hat from the lag-one product, kappa4(eps) from the per-site fourth cumulant with the chain's site-dependent factor, with the estimated and with the true rho.
predeclared_analysis: RMSE, dispersion and bias per level, paired by seed with E06's EM-BP rows; OLS log-slope of the RMSE on t >= 1 against 2 and 4.
motivation: Registered during the 18-19 September audit (reports/audit-2026-09-18.tex); the scratch computation that motivated it was run first on the laptop and is reproduced here under provenance.
